name: Godzilla vs. Sonic: First Encounter
summary: Godzilla vs. Sonic: First Encounter is a 2D action game that takes place in Japan. Demolish everything in sight and fire off Heat Rays as Godzilla in miniature rage rooms. Reach breakneck speeds and use the environment to blast off as Sonic in sprawling obstacle courses. Make the creatures throw down in world-shattering combat against robots, monsters, entire landmasses, and especially each other
